hero.subtitle: Plug Coinbase login into your app with one shared Code Exchange flow for web and mobile.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Coinbase uses the OAuth2 Authorization Code flow. After consent, the API calls GET /v2/user, creates a short-lived single-use exchange code in Redis, and your client exchanges it for the same JWTs you get from password login. Scopes wallet:user:email and wallet:user:read are required for email and profile.

console.title: Coinbase Developer Portal
console.description: Register an OAuth2 client in the Coinbase Developer Portal → set Redirect URI to COINBASE_CALLBACK_URL and request scopes wallet:user:email and wallet:user:read.

api.title: API contract
api.description: The API exposes a start URL and a callback that issues the exchange code.

codeHeader.label: Start
codeHeader.context: Redirect the user to Coinbase consent

codeHeader.label: Callback
codeHeader.context: Coinbase redirects back to the API

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: The Coinbase user id from GET /v2/user is stored as coinbaseId. Email and name come from the user profile when wallet:user:email and wallet:user:read scopes are granted.
